name: Tetrahydrocannabiphorol
summary: Tetrahydrocannabiphorol is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: Tetrahydrocannabiphorol (THCP) is a potent phytocannabinoid, a CB1 and CB2 receptor agonist which was known as a synthetic homologue of tetrahydrocannabinol (THC), but for the first time in 2019 was isolated as a trace natural product from Cannabis sativa.

uses.text: THCP was studied by Roger Adams as early as 1942.
